scope: User authorizes a new TUCam Mosaic camera, 20261022 coordinates, direction/exposure/timing admission then L6 remaining-stage capture. Old DVP data and L4 offline model are preserved. No TEST-based camera calibration, no model change, no optical device LUT change.
sensor_conversion: Fixed uint16 storage range 0..65535 to 0..255 after perspective sampling; original uint16 raw preserved. SDK ucDepth currently code2 is retained, not interpreted as2bits; reserved uiIndex0 is not used as hardware monotonic counter. This contract is not a claim of calibrated ADC effective bit depth. No per-image rescaling or TEST calibration.
